title: The rule that lower rounds must sit in earlier records is withdrawn; each round names the head it read and a new round reads a new head.
ruling: Coordinator, 15:56 CST Nov 8: withdrew the earlier own-rounds rule, because a named head proves more. At 16:03 CST the scope was set to a head on each Round line, with a gate that needs the top round on the live head. Coordinator readings at 15:18 CST: a new round reads a new head.
quote: The scope changed at 15:56 and 16:03 CST (coordinator). The earlier rule on this branch, "lower rounds must sit in earlier records", is withdrawn: decision `pr-review-record` lets a record list rounds that read earlier heads. ... A new round reads a new head (coordinator readings, 15:18 CST).
